column1: # The documentation as wiki pages: the file in the repository, a tab, and the page it becomes.
# Both languages are published, Chinese first: the Chinese page takes the plain name and the English one is
# the same name with `-EN`, so a page is two lines here and two in wiki-sidebar.md. The page name is what a
# reader sees in the address bar and what a link between pages has to name, so this is the one place to
# look when a page is added, removed or renamed. A page name may not contain a space. Order here is the
# order the sidebar lists the pages in; the sidebar itself is wiki-sidebar.md, and both files have to
# agree, which the publishing script checks before it writes anything.
# Each page carries the `简体中文 | English` line its source has, and the script turns it into a link to the
# other file of the pair: that is why both have to be listed here, and a page without a counterpart would
# send its reader to the repository instead.
# English: the same pages, in the same order.
